headline: Independent director Ramesh Kumar Chandak to step down at Dhunseri Investments
hook: Upcoming board vacancy at Dhunseri Investments
summary: Dhunseri Investments Limited has announced that Independent Director Ramesh Kumar Chandak will cease to hold office effective November 2, 2026. The company communicated the departure to the stock exchange through an official filing. Such board changes are procedural corporate governance updates for listed entities. Indian retail shareholders of the company should note the upcoming change in independent oversight.
why_it_matters: Routine board-level change with no immediate impact on stock fundamentals.

headline: Dhunseri Investments releases postal ballot voting results
hook: Dhunseri Investments concludes postal ballot process
summary: Dhunseri Investments Limited has submitted the official proceedings and voting results of its recent postal ballot to the NSE. The filing includes the scrutinizer's report detailing the outcome of shareholder resolutions. This is a routine corporate governance disclosure required for listed entities. Retail investors can review the specific resolutions passed through the exchange portal.
why_it_matters: Routine governance update with no immediate impact on share price.
